No later filing exists, so the FY2021 year is the last full-year audited set. | CRON 2026-11-22: H1 2022 and FY2021 appended from the audited cash flow statement in the same filed 2022 annual report (annualreport.cma.or.ke, scanned; OCR at 320 dpi).
